name: uk.co.armedpineapple.innoextract.service.ExtractService
description: The InnoExtract Android library (Alan Woolley) binds this service when an app checks or extracts an Inno Setup installer. It validates the input and extracts its contents to a file or folder destination while reporting progress.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to validate or extract Inno Setup installer files through this library.
